provider: Hosting by Design — App hosting 24 TB (owners of seedbox.io)

free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: The re-read app-hosting table prices plans by whole TB of HDD storage and outgoing data and publishes no per-object size cap; access is over SSH, not an object API.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No file-retention period is published; the consumer terms allow cancellation within fourteen days with at most 1 TB transferred, and state that services are irrevocably removed seven days after an unpaid invoice's payment term lapses.

egress.terms: The re-read table lists outgoing data per tier: 1 TB storage includes 3 TB out, 2 TB includes 6 TB, 4 TB includes 10 TB, 8 TB includes 25 TB, while the 18 TB, 24 TB and 28 TB dedicated tiers list Unlimited outgoing, each over a 10Gbit+ uplink.

interface_detail: SSH included, app installer (Plex/Sonarr/rTorrent etc.), 10 Gbit+ uplink
chaining: A hosted app-hosting box with SSH access and a 10Gbit+ uplink; the fair-use policy sets no strict transfer limit but asks users not to run the port at full capacity continuously.
limits_note: Metered egress below 18 TB; ~$2.42/TB only achievable at the 24 TB dedicated tier
reliability_note: Seedbox.io now 301-redirects to hostingby.design. Same operator (HNielsen Technologies ApS, DK). Brand consolidation means the old seedbox.io plans/prices are no longer separately purchasable.
